The town library opens beside the river each morning. Readers return books at the wooden desk, while volunteers arrange maps and repair worn covers. Upstairs, a quiet room looks across the bridge toward the station. The librarian keeps a notebook of questions that visitors ask, then uses those notes to choose new books for the shelves.
